crossRefs.note: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and…
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who…
Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…
He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all…

translations.web: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
translations.bsb: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
translations.kjv: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
translations.asv: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.
